profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Snowflake
profile.summary: Specialties: Enterprise software, scalable, distributed architectures

positions.title: Semi Retired
positions.description: Taking time off to spend more time with family and friends, do some traveling and catch up on life.  Engaging in some part time/contract work when there is something interesting.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description: Helping out a friend with some advising on a fun data management project at GreatSchools.org.  Some interesting challenges dealing with a truly diverse set of data sources.

positions.title: Metanaut
positions.description:
Member of the technical team responsible for a mix of individual contributor work and management.

Responsible for running the build/QA/release process.  Created and extend QA and release processes in order to improve product quality.  Spun up an off-shore QA team to improve depth of our release processes.

Also managed the API group (JDBC, ODBC and WebUI) that was responsible for building and maintaining the outward facing customer APIs for the analytics engine.

Individual contributor work included designing and implementing a SQL standards compliant authentication and authorization system for the core analytics engine.  Authentication architecture was designed to be extensible to incorporate a wide variety of enterprise integration scenarios (integration to enterprise LDAP, AD, SAML/SSO, Kerberos, PKI, etc).  Implemented foreign credential infrastructure for delegated authentication to federated data sources.

positions.title: VP Data Engine Engineering
positions.description: Managed the core engineering team working on our distributed, shared-nothing MPP data management/analytics engine.  Primary responsibilities included project scheduling, hiring, training and coordination of Engineering activities with the rest of the company and its business objectives.  Spun up an off-shore sustaining engineering team in India to improve product stability and responsiveness to customer escalation issues.

positions.title: Chief Architect
positions.description: Primary responsibilities were overseeing the scalability and extensibility of our data management engine and trail blazing new technologies for inclusion into our product stack.  Daily activities ranged from architecture proposals/reviews to analysis of customer requirements/feedback to hands-on coding of features and bug fixes.  Responsible for diagnosing and resolving scalability issues with our MPP, shared-nothing data management architecture to allow our customers to manage a petabyte or more of data within our product.  Architected and lead the development efforts to implement a FIPS-certified data-at-rest encryption engine to satisfy government-mandated data-security requirements.  Designed and implemented integration efforts to merge our scalable data management engine into certain well-known open source data management projects.

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description:
Was recruited by the founders as the first employee in the Company.  Was originally hired as the Senior Software Architect.  Architected and implemented SenSage distributed storage system.  Architected and shared implementation of SenSage networking layer.

Was promoted to Director of Engineering around September 2002.  Assigned responsibility to manage the core server team.

positions.title: VP Technical Development
positions.description:
Joined as second person in the Company.  Was originally hired as a Senior Software Architect.  Was promoted to VP of Technical Development around June 1992.  Took over all technical aspects of the Company's operation from building out the infrastructure to architecting and implementing the software that ran the Company's services as well as billing.

Served as Corporate Secretary for about 1 year, and was a member of the Board for about 18 months.  Stepped down to make room for new outside Board members.

Towards the end of my time there, I had a team of 5 people reporting directly to me, and became involved in the Company's M&A efforts.  Was part of the team that succeeded in merging our Company with another publc Company, providing liquidity for our investors.
